name: switch_filtered_tvs
ke_conversion: E_phase_peak = ke_scale * rpm/(sqrt(3)*KV); convention uncertainty is a sweep input
source_reverse_acceptance: blocked by Dsrc in this initial no-absorption baseline
arming: global gate-command ramp to requested PWM pattern over 2e-06 s; transient is reported separately from post-arm PWM interval
mosfet_behavior_model: passive behavioral B-channel conductance capped to 0..10V normalized command, Ron=0.005 ohm selected hot screen; no vendor macro model; fixed Coss=2.3e-09 F/device; behavioral body diode; gate transition timing from smoothed PWM comparator
bridge_bypass_model: 3 phase-leg branches, each one 4.7uF ceramic assumed 2.35uF at bias plus 0.1uF, Ceff=2.45e-06 F/leg; ESR=0.005 ohm, ESL=1e-09 H; bulk bank is separate
bus_voltage_feedforward: RC-filtered bus sample, tau=0.0001 s, R=100 ohm, C=1e-06 F
tvs_behavior_model: ST SMCJ40A linear high-current clamp proxy: TVS_INTERCEPT=49.1 V (upward-rounded from 64.5 V - 24 A*0.644 ohm = 49.044 V; NOT VBR(max)); RD(max)=0.644 ohm; no guaranteed low-current I-V, RD temperature coefficient, device capacitance, package inductance, thermal, or repetitive-pulse model
ov_comparator_timing: behavior-level threshold only; no official TLV1704 macro or worst-case propagation delay; independent BJT/OVP network checked separately
data_scope: ngspice measurements plus selected raw vectors; switch-level behavior screening, not closed-loop FOC qualification
